ground_truth: Halves the search space of a sorted array at each step by comparing the target to the middle element.
pre_quiz: Why cannot binary search be directly performed on an unsorted array?
pre_quiz_answer: Because eliminating half the elements requires knowing all elements to the left are smaller and to the right are larger.
post_quiz: If an array has 64 sorted elements, what is the maximum number of comparisons needed?
post_quiz_answer: At most 6 or 7 comparisons because log2(64) equals 6.
